**Reasoning**

The only open route from the shelter to anyone waiting runs through Myagang temple (20 min). Tadi farm is a further 22 min beyond it. A round trip costs 40 min to the temple and 84 min if it extends to Tadi farm.

| Option | Driving | Penalties | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rescue everyone (one trip via Tadi farm, one to the temple) | 84 + 40 | 0 | 124 |
| Two temple trips, defer 2 adults at Tadi farm | 40 + 40 | 2 × 20 = 40 | **120** |
| One temple trip (3 elderly and 1 adult), defer 4 adults | 40 | 4 × 20 = 80 | **120** |
| One trip via Tadi farm, defer the 4 people left at the temple | 84 | 50 + 3 × 20 = 110 | 194 |

The minimum cost is 120, and two options reach it. I chose the two-trip plan because it rescues 6 people instead of 4. It defers only the 2 adults at Tadi farm, whose collection would add 44 min of driving but only avoid a 40-point penalty.

<plan>
defer tadi-farm adult 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 adult 2
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 adult 2
</plan>

COST: 120
